import html from typing import List # Template for rendering a user post. Placeholders are: # {username} - the author of the post # {title} - the title of the post # {body} - the body content of the post # {tags} - a string containing elements for each tag USER_POST_FORMAT = ( "
\n" "
\n" "

{title}

\n" "

Posted by {username}

\n" "
\n" "
\n" " {body}\n" "
\n" "
\n" " {tags}\n" "
\n" "
" ) def render_user_post( username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str] ) -> str: """ Render a user-generated post as sanitized HTML. Parameters ---------- username : str The name of the user who created the post. post_title : str The title of the post. post_body : str The main content of the post. tags : List[str] A list of tags added by the user. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string representing the post. """ # Escape user-provided data to prevent XSS safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) # For the body we escape but preserve line breaks as
safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Render tags as elements safe_tags = " ".join( f'{html.escape(tag, quote=True)}' for tag in tags ) return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags )
